definitions.explanation: Describes someone who can endure hardship, frustration, or difficulty without giving up. Emphasizes the ability to bear with something over a long period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{辛抱強|しんぼうづよ}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
{辛抱強|しんぼうづよ}く⟦{待|ま}っていれば→待つ：00469_matsu⟧、⟦きっと→きっと：00860_kitto⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧いく。
examples.english: If you wait patiently, it will surely work out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{辛抱強|しんぼうづよ}く⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher patiently explained it to me again and again.

notes:
{辛抱強|しんぼうづよ}い describes someone who can patiently endure hardship, frustration, or difficulty over a long period without giving up.

FORMS:
⟦{辛抱|しんぼう}→辛抱：05101_shinbou⟧ (patience, endurance) + ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (strong).
- Adverbial: {辛抱強|しんぼうづよ}く ({辛抱強|しんぼうづよ}く⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ — to wait patiently)
- Noun form: {辛抱強|しんぼうづよ}さ (patience, tenacity)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {辛抱強|しんぼうづよ}い: patient, persevering (emphasis on steadfast endurance through difficulty)
- ⟦{我慢強|がまんづよ}い→我慢強い：07164_gamanzuyoi⟧: patient, enduring (emphasis on suppressing discomfort or desires)
- ⟦{根気強|こんきづよ}い→根気強い：21760_konkizuyoi⟧: persistent, tenacious (emphasis on continued effort)
- ⟦{忍耐強|にんたいづよ}い→忍耐強い：15589_nintaizuyoi⟧: patient (more formal/literary)

USAGE:
All four share the 〜{強|づよ}い pattern, which means "strong in ~" and creates adjectives describing psychological resilience.
